reason: Conversation 1 asked the questions the hidden truth needed (flashing-light pattern, stage, restart behaviour, full model number), kept a genuine differential open (pump, brushes, pressure switch), gave safe no-panel checks only after she said she wouldn't open it, and closed with a concise fault summary to hand to an engineer. Conversation 2 anchored on the drain pump from the first reply, never asked about codes or the model, barely acknowledged pressure-switch or control faults, and spent three near-identical turns repeating the same impeller check.
